title: Warm Smoky Chinese Mushroom Stew
description: A herbal and velvety Chinese dish featuring mixed spices and smoky flavors, cooked to perfection in a claypot, this stew is an energizing and comforting meal for any time of day. It combines the earthy flavors of mixed mushrooms with the depth of smoky spices.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a claypot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir fry until fragrant.
Add the mixed mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the smoked paprika, Chinese five spice, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in 2 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sesame oil and chopped scallions.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
